title: Tesla's AI Just Passed the Human Test
full_monologue: **Tesla's Self Driving AI Just Passed the Human Test**. Recent tests show Tesla's Autopilot can now handle complex driving scenarios as well as, if not better than, human drivers. Think sudden lane changes, unpredictable pedestrians, and chaotic city traffic — all mastered by AI. This isn’t just a leap forward for autonomous vehicles; it’s a game-changer for road safety and transportation. The implications are huge, and we’re only scratching the surface. What do you think? Is this the future of driving?
